topic: Animal Body Parts and Their Functions
key_concepts: Animals have different body parts that vary by kind.
Animals use body parts to move, eat, swim, breathe, and protect themselves.
Beak, teeth, mouth, and tongue are used for getting food.
Horns and tail are used for protection from other animals.
Feet are used for walking, running, and jumping.
Fins and tail are used for swimming.
Gills are used by fish to breathe underwater.
Carabaos, cows, and goats use horns and tails for protection.
Frogs use their legs for jumping to escape larger animals.
Chickens use their beak for eating.
